transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

What scared me enough to come in is… I keep thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes, driving home from the clinic, I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just didn’t turn the wheel. That’s not normal for me, and it scared me.
How often have you been having these thoughts about not waking up or not turning the wheel, and when did they first start?

It’s been happening pretty often lately. The not-waking-up thought comes up a lot, and the driving one has happened a few times on the way home from the clinic. I don’t know the exact first day it started, but it’s recent enough that it scared me and made me think I needed to come in.
Can you describe how often these thoughts occur in a typical day or week, and do they come in waves or feel constant?

It’s not every minute, but it comes up a lot during the day. The “maybe it would be easier if I didn’t wake up” thought kind of pops in and out, like waves, especially when I’m alone or worn down. The driving thought isn’t constant—it’s happened a few times on the way home from the clinic, and it scares me when it does.
Have you made any specific plans or thought about how you might act on these thoughts?

I haven’t made a plan like that. It’s more that the thoughts hit me—like wishing I just wouldn’t wake up, or when I’m driving, wondering what would happen if I didn’t turn the wheel. I haven’t acted on it, but the fact that I’m even thinking that scares me.
How long have these thoughts been persisting each day, and have you noticed if they tend to improve or get worse at certain times of the day?

It can hang around for a while when it starts—kind of comes and goes during the day rather than staying constant. The worst is when I’m worn out, especially after the clinic or when I’m driving home. That’s when I catch myself thinking, what if I just didn’t turn the wheel. And other times it’s that thought that it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. It scares me.
How long have you been feeling this way overall? Have these feelings been present every day for at least two weeks, or have they been more intermittent?

It’s been about a month overall. Since we took in our relative, it’s felt like this intense up-and-down crisis, and it hasn’t really let up much. It feels like it’s been there most days, not just a one-off thing.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things you used to enjoy, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you previously looked forward to?

Yes. I really have. I haven’t touched my camera, and I used to love taking pictures. I’ll look at the bird feeders, but I don’t really care the way I normally would. And the garden… usually I’m always thinking about what’s coming up next, but now I just don’t. That part scares me, because those things used to make me feel like myself.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past couple of weeks?

Yes. Most days it feels like the color has drained out of everything. Even when the house is busy, I just feel… flat and hopeless. I’ve been crying in the laundry room because I can’t stand anyone seeing me like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating much less or more than usual?

Yeah… my appetite’s been really uneven. Lately I mostly just pick at something like toast, or I’ll have coffee, and then I get to the end of a clinic shift and realize I’ve barely eaten anything all day.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

Yeah… more the restless side, I think. I got really driven for a while—taking extra shifts, redoing the whole household care schedule, calling contractors, trying to coordinate everyone’s tasks like it was some big hospital project. Nobody asked me to take all that on, but I felt like I had to keep pushing and organizing everything.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt persistently down, lost interest in things, or had thoughts like these?
Yes. It’s been going on for a long time, honestly. I’d say this heaviness has been hanging over me for about 11 months now. This past month has just made it feel unbearable.
Have you had any periods of feeling better in between these episodes of feeling down, or has it been a steady continuation of this low mood without significant improvement?

It’s been more of a steady continuation. I don’t think I’ve really had a stretch where I felt back to normal. The low mood has been hanging over me for about 11 months, and then this past month it just got a lot harder to handle.
Before this current time, have you ever had other periods in your life where you felt this persistently down and lost interest in things, or are these feelings completely new for you?

I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that was clearly like this before. I’ve had rough periods, but this level of being down and not interested in things… I don’t know, it feels different enough that I can’t say for sure.
Before these past 11 months, can you remember a time when you felt this persistently down for at least a couple of months without a clear break in between?

I don’t really remember a time like that before this. I’ve had times where I was stressed or unhappy, but not something that stayed this heavy for months without a break. At least, nothing that stands out to me clearly.
